parts.text:
ACTION=A4
Rationale: The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph (approximately 13.9 m/s) while the lead vehicle is directly ahead at 28 meters with a much slower velocity of 4.6 m/s. This rapidly closing gap requires strong deceleration (braking) to maintain a safe following distance and avoid a rear-end collision. Action A4 corresponds to braking/deceleration.
